lines.text: Why does a week have seven days?

phrases.text: Why does a week have seven days?

lines.text: Almost everything on your calendar comes from the sky. Except the week.

lines.text: A day is one spin of the Earth.

lines.text: A month is roughly one lunar cycle, about twenty-nine and a half days.

lines.text: But historians trace the seven back to Babylon, where sky-watchers tracked seven moving lights.
